# GitHub Copilot

Copilot (VS Code, Copilot CLI and the Copilot cloud agent) supports the open Agent Skills standard, so the
skill works as-is. These prompt files add one slash command per governance workflow.

## Install

1. Copy `skills/ai-product-governance/` into your repository at `.github/skills/ai-product-governance/`
   (or `.agents/skills/`), or install it with `npx skills add joydeep195/ai-product-governance`.
2. Copy `.github/prompts/` from this folder into your repository's `.github/prompts/`.
3. In Copilot Chat, type `/` and pick a command.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/ai-intake` | Decide whether a use case needs AI at all (Gate 0) and produce a use-case brief with a fit verdict. |
| `/ai-business-case` | Price an AI feature per completed task and decide whether it is worth building (Gate 1). |
| `/ai-prd` | Write an AI PRD with a fit verdict, quality bar, failure design, economics, risk tier, controls and rollout. |
| `/ai-eval-plan` | Define the quality bar, golden set, grading methods and thresholds for an AI feature (Gate 2). |
| `/ai-risk-review` | Classify the risk tier against the policy, build the risk register and map required controls (Gate 3). |
| `/ai-launch-review` | Decide Go, Go with conditions or No-go for an AI launch and plan a staged rollout (Gate 4). |
| `/ai-regression-review` | Diagnose why an AI feature got worse, or review an AI incident, using the Gate 5 protocol. |
| `/ai-model-decision` | Choose the approach (prompting, RAG, agent, fine-tuning) and model on evidence, and record the decision. |

For the deterministic tools without running scripts, also connect the MCP server (see `../mcp/`).
